source.method: Cycle 34 frozen technical-document sections; retain heading plus a whitespace-bounded excerpt at most 512 UTF-16 code units. Repetitions are labeled and are not independent real documents.
source.limits: Single English technical self-documentation corpus, repeated excerpts and deterministic synthetic lexical controls; no representative traffic or relevance-quality claim.

costs.importedCode: Selected-source capture and copy-on-write directory staging; no phrase verifier.
costs.retainedRepresentation: One entry per record, present selected field and original value; selected original UTF-16 strings only.
costs.transientWork: Changed selected-field values and touched source-directory buckets; shared mutation budget.

costs.importedCode: Native analyzer and selected-position copy-on-write staging; no phrase verifier.
costs.retainedRepresentation: Record, selected-field/value and term containers, ordered occurrences with positionLength 1, and two original span coordinates only for selected offset fields; no display source or metadata.
costs.transientWork: One native analysis per changed selected value, occurrence construction and touched directory buckets; shared mutation budget.

costs.importedCode: Selected-position protocol and resumable occurrence-position intersection; no source reanalysis.
costs.retainedRepresentation: No additional index state; position providers retain declared term occurrences and optionally original spans.
costs.transientWork: Sorted occurrence lists are intersected with ordered query offsets independently in each original value; complete lexical candidates and selected providers are checked under the shared search budget.

completeMembership.scope: Every all-query membership page, outside timing; exact total/revision, unique ids, zero scores and ordinal tie order.

exercise.scope: One actual donor/receiver per case; ordinary wall/CPU excludes metadata/hash/postcondition work. Diagnostic observations are intrusive, not normal timings or retained/peak heap.
